Neoadjuvant / adjuvant / perioperative (simple)
records.text: Treatment before the main treatment is neoadjuvant; extra treatment afterwards aims to lower the chance of cancer returning. The purpose and actual delivery matter.

records.name: Lines of therapy (simple)
records.text: A line is a treatment strategy for a stated disease setting. Several drugs or planned stages can belong to one line.

records.name: Tumour-bed biopsy after neoadjuvant therapy (simple)
records.text: A biopsy after drug treatment samples parts of the former breast tumour bed. A negative sample can miss remaining cancer and does not by itself establish that surgery can be omitted.

records.name: Perioperative immune window (simple)
records.text: Surgery can temporarily change immune activity. Blood or laboratory changes do not by themselves show more recurrences or prove that a different anaesthetic improves outcomes.

records.name: KEYNOTE-522 (simple)
records.text: This trial tested adding pembrolizumab before and after surgery to the same chemotherapy plan. It measured response and survival.

records.name: KEYNOTE-355 (simple)
records.text: The trial found a survival benefit in its defined group with previously untreated advanced triple-negative breast cancer. Earlier early-stage treatment did not always exclude people.

records.name: OlympiA (simple)
records.text: A year of olaparib improved outcomes in selected people with high-risk early breast cancer and inherited BRCA1 or BRCA2 variants. The trial also required HER2-negative disease.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (ar)
records.text: تختبر ما إذا كان إعطاء ADC موجه لـ TROP2 بعد الجراحة يمكن أن يشفي عددًا أكبر من مريضات سرطان الثدي الثلاثي السلبي اللواتي نجا سرطانهن من العلاج الكيميائي المناعي قبل الجراحة.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (de)
records.text: Prüft, ob die Gabe eines TROP2-ADC nach der Operation mehr jener dreifach negativen Patientinnen heilen kann, deren Krebs die präoperative Chemo-Immuntherapie überlebt hat.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (es)
records.text: Evalúa si administrar un ADC anti-TROP2 tras la cirugía puede curar a más pacientes triple negativas cuyo cáncer sobrevivió a la quimioinmunoterapia preoperatoria.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (fr)
records.text: Teste si l'administration d'un ADC anti-TROP2 après la chirurgie peut guérir davantage de patientes triple négatives dont le cancer a survécu à la chimio-immunothérapie préopératoire.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (hi)
records.text: यह परखता है कि सर्जरी के बाद TROP2 ADC देने से क्या उन ट्रिपल-निगेटिव रोगियों में से अधिक को ठीक किया जा सकता है जिनका कैंसर सर्जरी-पूर्व कीमो-इम्यूनोथेरेपी के बाद भी बचा रह गया।

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (ja)
records.text: 術前の化学免疫療法後にがんが残存したトリプルネガティブ乳がん患者に対し、術後にTROP2 ADCを投与することでより多くの患者を治癒できるかを検証する試験である。

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (pt)
records.text: Testa se administrar um ADC anti-TROP2 após a cirurgia pode curar mais pacientes triplo-negativas cujo câncer sobreviveu à quimioimunoterapia pré-operatória.

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (zh)
records.text: 检验术后给予TROP2 ADC能否治愈更多癌症在术前化疗免疫治疗后仍存留的三阴性乳腺癌患者。

records.name: ASCENT-05 / OptimICE-RD (AFT-65, GBG 119, NSABP B-63) (simple)
records.text: Tests whether a TROP2 antibody-drug after surgery can cure more triple-negative patients whose cancer survived pre-surgery treatment.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (ar)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03 هي النسخة المقابلة لـ ASCENT-05 باستخدام Dato-DXd: مقترن ADC، مع العلاج المناعي أو بدونه، لمريضات سرطان الثدي الثلاثي السلبي اللواتي بقي لديهن سرطان متبقٍ عند الجراحة.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (de)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03 ist das Dato-DXd-Gegenstück zu ASCENT-05: ein ADC, mit oder ohne Immuntherapie, für dreifach negative Patientinnen mit Resttumor bei der Operation.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (es)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03 es el equivalente con Dato-DXd de ASCENT-05: un ADC, con o sin inmunoterapia, para pacientes triple negativas con cáncer residual en la cirugía.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (fr)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03 est le pendant Dato-DXd d'ASCENT-05 : un ADC, avec ou sans immunothérapie, pour les patientes triple négatives présentant un cancer résiduel lors de la chirurgie.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (hi)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03, ASCENT-05 का Dato-DXd समकक्ष है: सर्जरी के समय बचे हुए कैंसर वाली ट्रिपल-निगेटिव मरीजों के लिए इम्यूनोथेरेपी के साथ या उसके बिना एक ADC।

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (ja)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03はASCENT-05のDato-DXd版に当たる試験で、手術時にがんが残存していたトリプルネガティブ患者に対し、免疫療法併用または非併用でADCを用いる。

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (pt)
records.text: O TROPION-Breast03 é o equivalente com Dato-DXd do ASCENT-05: um ADC, com ou sem imunoterapia, para pacientes triplo-negativas com câncer residual na cirurgia.

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (zh)
records.text: TROPION-Breast03是与ASCENT-05对应的Dato-DXd试验：对手术时仍有残留癌灶的三阴性患者，使用ADC联合或不联合免疫治疗。

records.name: TROPION-Breast03 (simple)
records.text: The Datroway version of ASCENT-05, for triple-negative patients with leftover cancer at surgery.

records.name: Regimen and cycles (simple)
records.text: A regimen sets out the medicines, amounts and timing. A cycle is a defined period of treatment and recovery; its length depends on the plan.

records.name: Anthracyclines (doxorubicin, epirubicin) (simple)
records.text: Anthracyclines affect DNA and an enzyme that cuts and reseals it. They can also harm the heart, sometimes after treatment has ended.

records.name: De-escalation, escalation and response-adapted therapy (simple)
records.text: A response test can guide a planned next step, but the rule and its effects need evidence. A favourable result alone does not show that less treatment is safe.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (ar)
records.text: الامتناع عن علاج السرطان عن قصد في الوقت الحالي، مع مراقبته بانتظام بفحوص الدم أو التصوير أو الخزعات، وعلاجه فقط إذا ظهرت علامات على تقدمه. وهو النهج المعياري لسرطان البروستاتا منخفض الخطورة والكتل الكلوية الصغيرة وعدة حالات أخرى بطيئة التطور.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (de)
records.text: Einen Krebs bewusst noch nicht zu behandeln, ihn aber regelmäßig mit Bluttests, Bildgebung oder Biopsien zu kontrollieren und erst dann zu behandeln, wenn er Anzeichen eines Fortschreitens zeigt. Standard bei Prostatakrebs mit niedrigem Risiko, kleinen Nierentumoren und mehreren anderen langsam verlaufenden Erkrankungen.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (es)
records.text: No tratar un cáncer todavía, de forma deliberada, pero controlarlo regularmente con análisis de sangre, pruebas de imagen o biopsias y tratarlo solo si muestra signos de progresar. Es lo habitual en el cáncer de próstata de bajo riesgo, las masas renales pequeñas y varias otras enfermedades lentas.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (fr)
records.text: Ne pas traiter volontairement un cancer pour l'instant, mais le surveiller régulièrement par des analyses de sang, des examens d'imagerie ou des biopsies, et ne traiter que s'il montre des signes de progression. C'est la norme pour le cancer de la prostate à faible risque, les petites masses rénales et plusieurs autres affections d'évolution lente.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (hi)
records.text: जानबूझकर किसी कैंसर का अभी इलाज न करना, बल्कि रक्त परीक्षण, स्कैन या बायोप्सी से नियमित जाँच करना और तभी इलाज करना जब उसमें बढ़ने के संकेत दिखें। कम जोखिम वाले प्रोस्टेट कैंसर, छोटी किडनी गाँठों और कई अन्य धीमी बीमारियों के लिए यह मानक है।

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (ja)
records.text: がんをあえてまだ治療せず、血液検査、画像検査、生検で定期的に確認し、進行の兆候が見られた場合にのみ治療する方法である。低リスクの前立腺がん、小さな腎腫瘤、その他いくつかの進行の遅い病態で標準となっている。

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (pt)
records.text: Deliberadamente não tratar um câncer ainda, mas acompanhá-lo regularmente com exames de sangue, exames de imagem ou biópsias e tratar apenas se houver sinais de progressão. É o padrão para câncer de próstata de baixo risco, pequenas massas renais e várias outras condições de evolução lenta.

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (zh)
records.text: 有意暂不治疗癌症，而是通过血液检查、影像扫描或活检定期监测，只有在出现进展迹象时才治疗。这是低风险前列腺癌、小的肾脏肿块和其他几种进展缓慢的疾病的标准做法。

records.name: Active surveillance and observation (simple)
records.text: Active surveillance means deliberately not treating a cancer yet but checking it regularly and treating only if it shows signs of progressing, standard for low-risk prostate cancer.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (ar)
records.text: ما إذا كان هدف العلاج القضاء على السرطان نهائياً (شافٍ) أو السيطرة عليه وتخفيف الأعراض وإطالة العمر عندما يكون الشفاء غير ممكن (تلطيفي). النية، لا الدواء، هي التي تحدد الكلمة: فالعلاج الكيميائي نفسه يمكن أن يكون أياً منهما.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (de)
records.text: Ob das Ziel der Behandlung darin besteht, den Krebs dauerhaft zu beseitigen (kurativ), oder ihn zu kontrollieren, Symptome zu lindern und das Leben zu verlängern, wenn Heilung nicht möglich ist (palliativ). Die Absicht, nicht das Medikament, bestimmt das Wort: Dieselbe Chemotherapie kann beides sein.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (es)
records.text: Si el objetivo del tratamiento es eliminar el cáncer definitivamente (curativo) o controlarlo, aliviar los síntomas y prolongar la vida cuando la curación no es posible (paliativo). La intención, no el fármaco, define la palabra: la misma quimioterapia puede ser cualquiera de las dos.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (fr)
records.text: Selon que l'objectif du traitement est d'éliminer le cancer pour de bon (curatif) ou de le contrôler, de soulager les symptômes et de prolonger la vie quand la guérison n'est pas possible (palliatif). C'est l'intention, et non le médicament, qui définit le mot : la même chimiothérapie peut être l'un ou l'autre.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (hi)
records.text: उपचार का लक्ष्य कैंसर को हमेशा के लिए समाप्त करना है (क्यूरेटिव) या, जब इलाज संभव न हो, उसे नियंत्रित करना, लक्षणों से राहत देना और जीवन बढ़ाना (पैलिएटिव)। इस शब्द को दवा नहीं, इरादा परिभाषित करता है: एक ही कीमोथेरेपी दोनों में से कोई भी हो सकती है।

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (ja)
records.text: 治療の目的が、がんを完全に取り除くこと（根治的）なのか、治癒が望めない場合に病勢を抑え、症状を和らげ、生命を延ばすこと（緩和的）なのかを表す。この言葉を定義するのは薬ではなく意図である。同じ化学療法がどちらにもなり得る。

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (pt)
records.text: Se o objetivo do tratamento é eliminar o câncer de vez (curativo) ou controlá-lo, aliviar os sintomas e prolongar a vida quando a cura não é possível (paliativo). A intenção, não o fármaco, define a palavra: a mesma quimioterapia pode ser qualquer uma das duas.

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (zh)
records.text: 治疗目标是彻底消除癌症（根治性），还是在无法治愈时控制疾病、缓解症状并延长生命（姑息性）。定义这个词的是意图而非药物：同一种化疗可以是其中任何一种。

records.name: Curative intent vs palliative intent (simple)
records.text: Curative intent means the goal is to eliminate the cancer for good, while palliative intent means controlling it and relieving symptoms when cure is not possible.
